'''Sun berries''' are an [[above ground|aboveground]] [[plant]] found naturally growing only in [[good]] areas. They have a high value and can be [[brewing|brewed]] into sunshine, the highest-[[value]] [[alcohol]] in ''Dwarf Fortress''. While high value does not increase the chance of a [[dwarf]] having a happy [[thought]], it may increase the effect of such a thought. [[Caravan]]s that travel to your fortress from good areas may bring stacks of sun berries or bags of seeds for trade; this can allow you to set up a sun berry [[Farming|farm]] anywhere outdoor crops will grow, as long as you are in an adequate biome.

Some dwarves [[preference|like]] sun berries for their ''inner light''.
